title: US single release: Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band/With A Little Help From My Friends | 1978
content:
The Beatles’ ‘Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band’/‘With A Little Help From My Friends’ was released as a single in the USA on 14 August 1978.

It was issued shortly after the release of the film Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band, which starred Peter Frampton and The Bee Gees.

The single was not a commercial success, peaking at 71 on the Billboard Hot 100, and 92 on the Cash Box chart. The b-side was ‘A Day In The Life’.

It was released in the UK on 22 September but fared only slightly better, reaching number 63 on the singles chart.
